# pve_storage_scan_cifs (Data Source)

CIFS shares discovered by scanning from a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_scan_cifs" "example" {
node = "pve1"
server = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `server` (String) The server address (name or IP).

### Optional

- `domain` (String) SMB domain (Workgroup).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password.
- `username` (String) User name.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/scan/cifs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Descriptive text from server.
- `share` (String) The cifs share name.
